articles.title: Govt launches Rs 10,000 Cr Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 to bridge early-stage funding gap in deep tech
articles.summary: The Government of India has launched the Startup India Fund of Funds 2.0 (FoF 2.0) with a substantial corpus of Rs 10,000 crore. This key initiative aims to significantly boost the national startup ecosystem by mobilising crucial venture and growth capital. FoF 2.0 seeks to empower Indian startups across diverse sectors, fostering innovation and economic development, thereby strengthening the nation's entrepreneurial spirit and capabilities.

articles.title: Andhra Pradesh launches India’s first quantum reference facility in Amaravati
articles.summary: Andhra Pradesh Chief Minister N Chandrababu Naidu launched a quantum reference facility, a significant step towards establishing India's first sovereign hardware ecosystem. This initiative aims to accelerate indigenous manufacturing capabilities, reducing technological dependence and fostering self-reliance in critical tech sectors. It highlights a national push for advanced technological development and strategic autonomy.

articles.title: Taylor Swift Leads 2026 American Music Awards Noms With Eight, as Olivia Dean and Sombr Follow Close Behind: Complete List of Nominees
articles.summary: Pop superstar Taylor Swift leads nominations for the 2026 American Music Awards, aiming to extend her historic record as the most awarded artist. This significant achievement underscores her continued dominance and global influence in the music industry. Her consistent success on such an international platform demonstrates sustained excellence, a quality valued in various fields.
